source.ref: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/6652; AACR-Bench dataset.json rows 1500, 1501, 1502, 1503, 1504; hand-checked 2026-10-23 by vetter A and vetter B, disagreement on row-1503 hand-checked 2026-10-23 by adjudicator; licence MIT from LICENSE and both pyproject.toml files at head; row-1500 and row-1503 fixed before merge by 0b6ab6ef21 and 1fcdf34785 (squash-merged as e3cf852307), row-1502 fixed upstream by 85787cf53e (#7303)

rationale: The pull request adds a Parser component that formats a Data or DataFrame with a template or stringifies it. row-1502 is required: a Data input is formatted with only its text, so the Data keys the Template field's info tells users to reference raise KeyError; upstream switched to the Data's own keys in #7303 (author-fix). row-1500 is required, rewritten with its consequence: _clean_args rejects every list before the stringify check, so a list of Data (the Data output of URL, Directory, API Request and others) cannot be stringified although convert_to_string handles lists; the pull request's later commit moved the stringify check first (author-fix). row-1503 is optional (the vetters split; adjudicated): it is true at head and _validate_input was removed before merge (author-fix), but no flow can deliver a dict to input_data, since it is a HandleInput of field type other, which build_params never fills from a template value, apply_tweaks spreads a dict tweak into the field's keys, and edges carry Data or DataFrame; only a direct Python caller reaches it, and the correctness reviewer is told to skip inputs it cannot show are reachable. AACR marks row-1503 human, but the pull request thread shows the GitHub Copilot bot posted it. row-1501 is dropped: the columns-key heuristic only sees plain dicts, which flows do not deliver, and a Data instance is matched before it. row-1504 is dropped: hasattr cannot raise, since Component.__getattr__ raises AttributeError for a missing field and cleaning is then skipped. No forbid seeds for this pull request.

expect.concern: A Data input is formatted with only text=data.get_text(), so any placeholder other than {text}, including the Data's own keys that the Template field's info tells users to reference, raises a KeyError.

parse_combined_text runs _clean_args, which rejects every list, before it checks stringify, so with Stringify enabled a list of Data from an upstream component fails with a ValueError and convert_to_string's list branch can never run.
With Stringify enabled, a dict with a data key passes _clean_args but then fails _validate_input, which does not allow dict, so an input template mode accepts raises a TypeError in stringify mode.
